items.title: Learn quantum computing with IBM Quantum
items.summary: A free learning portal with lessons and interactive material for building a foundation in quantum computing. This starter resource is provided so the site is useful before the first automated refresh.
items.author: IBM Quantum

items.title: Quantum computing for the very curious
items.summary: An accessible, interactive introduction to core ideas behind quantum computing. Use it as a learning resource; it is not a news article or a peer-reviewed research paper.
